description: You are a clinical researcher at a pharmaceutical company conducting a systematic drug interaction study for an oncology pharmacovigilance dossier. You need to document the simultaneous interaction profile of crizotinib against two co-medications that frequently co-occur in the target patient population: acenocoumarol (used for atrial fibrillation management in elderly lung cancer patients) and fluconazole (used for antifungal prophylaxis in immunocompromised patients during chemotherapy). Using the Liverpool Cancer iChart Archive app, perform a single combined interaction query: select crizotinib as the cancer drug, then select both acenocoumarol and fluconazole simultaneously as co-medications before submitting the query. The Results screen should show the interaction ratings for both co-medication pairings with crizotinib at the same time. Remain on the Results screen showing both concurrent interaction results when finished.
